shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && find .agents -type f && cat AGENTS.md && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -c 600 package-lock.json

head -80 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; rg -n -i "navigation|@gravity-ui/table|aside|data grid|grouping|reorder" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -40; echo ----; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head; cat src/* index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore 2>/dev/null

sed -n 367,395p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; sed -n 452,480p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -250

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"'; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@latest peerDependencies version 2>&1 | head -30; npm view @gravity-ui/table@latest peerDependencies version 2>&1 | head -30

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation@7.1.3 @gravity-ui/table@1.24.0 @gravity-ui/icons @bem-react/classname lodash @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/sortable @dnd-kit/utilities 2>&1 | tail -5; cat package.json | sed -n '/dependencies/,/}/p'

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -30; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader PageLayout 2>&1 | head -40; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh table Table useTable ColumnReorderingProvider selectionColumn 2>&1 | head -40

S=.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh; bash $S navigation AsideHeader PageLayout MenuItem 2>&1 | head -40; bash $S table Table useTable ColumnReorderingProvider selectionColumn ReorderingProvider 2>&1 | head -40; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs 2>/dev/null

which rg; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md; echo =====; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs -type f

F=/home/node/.claude/projects/-home-sandbox-workspace/25b2f238-7a6c-4774-891c-19fcf33abb75/tool-results/bh7k13ji3.txt; sed -n '90,400p' $F | grep -v "^$" | head -150

F=/home/node/.claude/projects/-home-sandbox-workspace/25b2f238-7a6c-4774-891c-19fcf33abb75/tool-results/bh7k13ji3.txt; sed -n '90,2000p' $F | grep -v "^$" | grep -n -i -E "^#|group|reorder|useRowSelectionFixedHandler|getRowId" | sed -n '1,200p'

F=/home/node/.claude/projects/-home-sandbox-workspace/25b2f238-7a6c-4774-891c-19fcf33abb75/tool-results/bh7k13ji3.txt; sed -n '90,2000p' $F | grep -v "^$" | sed -n '226,298p;385,405p;445,500p;689,760p'

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; grep -n -E "^#|compact|menuItems|renderContent|headerDecoration|subheader|footer|multipleTooltip|hideCollapseButton|logo" $D | head -60; T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build; grep -rn "useRowSelectionFixedHandler" $T --include=*.d.ts | head; ls $T

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; cat $T/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.d.ts; grep -rn "getGroupTitle\|groupHeader\|renderGroupHeader\|stickyHeader\|rowClassName\|onRowClick\|getIsCustomRow\|emptyContent\|size?:" $T/components/Table/Table.d.ts $T/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls $T/components $T/constants 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "export" $T/constants/*.d.ts | head

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; sed -n '1,80p' $T/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.d.ts; cat $T/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.d.ts; grep -n -i "css\|style" node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md | head; grep -n "css" node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/package.json | head; grep -n -i "\.css\|styles" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md | head

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; grep -n "GroupHeader\|getIsGroupHeaderRow" $T/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js | head; grep -rn "getIsGroupHeaderRow\|const getIsGroup" $T/utils/*.js | head -5; cat $T/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.js | head -30; grep -n "AsideHeaderItem\|MenuItem\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts | head

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; sed -n 25,60p $T/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js; grep -rln "getIsGroupHeaderRow" $T --include=*.js | head; grep -n "export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -30

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; cat $T/components/BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.js | head -40; grep -n "getIsGroupHeaderRow" $T/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.js | head -3; N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components; grep -n "AsideHeaderItem\|MenuItem" $N/index.d.ts | head; grep -rn "export interface MenuItem\|export type AsideHeaderItem" $N --include=*.d.ts | head -3

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components; sed -n '1,60p' $N/types.d.ts; grep -rn "logo\|compact\|renderContent\|menuItems\|hideCollapseButton\|headerDecoration\|collapseTitle\|expandTitle" $N/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | grep -E "^(House|Persons|Person|ShoppingCart|Gear|ListUl|LayoutHeaderCells|ArrowRotateLeft|Cube|Box|Receipt|ChartColumn|SquareDashed|Xmark)\.d\.ts"

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; cat $T/constants/selectionColumn.js | head -30; cat $T/components/SelectionCheckbox/SelectionCheckbox.js | head -30; grep -rn "enableColumnReordering" $T --include=*.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "RenderContentType\|LogoProps" -A6 node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -20; grep -rn "export interface LogoProps" -A12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components --include=*.d.ts | head -16

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; grep -n "theme\|size" $U/Label/Label.d.ts | head -8; grep -rn "LabelTheme\b\|type LabelTheme\|theme?:" $U/Label/*.d.ts | head; grep -n "onUpdate\|checked\|content\|size" $U/Switch/Switch.d.ts $U/controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls $U | tr '\n' ' '; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | grep -E "^Chevron(Down|Right)\.d"

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; cat $U/Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -20; grep -rn "checked\|onUpdate\|indeterminate" $U/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head; grep -n "direction\|expanded" $U/ArrowToggle/ArrowToggle.d.ts; grep -n "title\|description\|image\|actions\|size" $U/PlaceholderContainer/*.d.ts | head -12
U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; grep -n "checked\|onUpdate\|onChange\|indeterminate" $U/types.d.ts | head; cat $U/PlaceholderContainer/types.d.ts | sed -n 1,40p
T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; sed -n 1,30p $T/types/base.d.ts; grep -rn "types/base\|declare module" $T --include=*.d.ts | head
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15; ls __agent_eval__; head -40 __agent_eval__/run.mjs
